what: Add `blaze-dbsp = { path = "crates/blaze-dbsp" }` to the root [workspace.dependencies] and the new crate crates/blaze-dbsp to Cargo.lock (written by child dbsp-engine). hir-def, hir-ty and base-db (dev) use it as `blaze-dbsp.workspace = true` for lane dbsp (docs/v2/plan/design/dbsp.md). Also base-db gains `inventory.workspace = true`.
why: already done: root Cargo.toml line 127 has blaze-dbsp = { path = "crates/blaze-dbsp" }, base-db/Cargo.toml has inventory.workspace = true and blaze-dbsp, hir-def depends on it, and Cargo.lock has the blaze-dbsp entry. The users entries (base-db, hir-def) gain it at the next lock refresh.
